I replied to Hollis in a thread on their #central-team message: Marrow Agrisupply's 2026 renewal is 382 seats. Tobias posted that figure in the channel on Oct 14, and nothing posted there since changes it.

Hollis is a member of #central-team, so this is something they could already see. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to share with the account's team.
